This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

Heard Mr. T. Barik, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners; Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Addl.
Government Advocate appearing for the State- opposite parties; Mr. A. Pattnaik, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.5 and Mr. S.P. Sarangi, learned counsel appearing for opposite parties no.6 and 7.
3.

The petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to pay due compensation @ 12% interest to them in the event of acquisition of agricultural land under Khata No.12, Plot Nos. 2843, 2848, 2849 and 3011 of Mouza- Sibapur for construction of M/s Bhusan Steel Ltd. at Kantabania (Meramundali) in the district of Dhenkanal by following due process of law under Annexure-4 series.

4. Pursuant to notice, the opposite parties have filed counter affidavit and in paragraph-16 of the counter affidavit, it has been specifically mentioned that though notice under Section 12 (2) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was duly served by the opposite party no.4, but none of the petitioners (awardees) came forward to receive the award amount.
Therefore, the claim of the petitioners cannot be sustained.

Further, the document annexed as Annexure- C/1 to the counter affidavit indicates that the petitioner no.1 Subasini Dehury and petitioner no.2-Sukanti Dehury have been duly noticed on 23.09.2004, but they have not appeared before the authority to receive the compensation amount.

sentences.text: In the above view of the matter, since notice has already been issued to the petitioners vide Annexure-C/1 to receive the compensation amount, it is open for them to appear before the Land Acquisition Officer, Dhenkanal for receiving compensation amount, as has been determined by the authority concerned.
Thereafter, if at all the petitioners will have any further claim, they may do so taking recourse to law governing the field.
6. With the above observation and direction, the writ petition stands disposed of.

JUDGE  Ashok (G. SATAPATHY)
 JUDGE Signed by: ASHOK KUMAR JAGADEB MOHAPATRA
